name_zh: 多米尼加/棒球/侨民经济：儒商传承与侨民驱动发展
name_en: Dominican Republic/Baseball/Diaspora Economy: Confucian Merchant Legacy & Diaspora-Driven Development
description_zh: 多米尼加棒球/大联盟 10%+ 球员/萨米·索萨/大卫·奥尔蒂斯/佩德罗·马丁内斯/侨民汇款 10%+ GDP/旅游/自由区/黄金/镍/特鲁希略 (1930-61)/巴尔加韦尔/梅迪纳/阿比纳德尔/海地关系/边境/市场/文化。核心模式：侨民驱动儒商发展 — 棒球人才/侨民网络/汇款/儒商家族/长期主义/教育/慈善/跨国经营/海地劳工/边境贸易。体现 M210 侨民驱动儒商发展 — 以"棒球人才管道+侨民汇款引擎+儒商家族网络+海地边境经济"四位一体，在独裁遗产/海地冲突/中等收入陷阱/气候脆弱四重挑战中构建侨民驱动发展模式。
description_en: Dominican Republic baseball/MLB 10%+ players/Sammy Sosa/David Ortiz/Pedro Martinez/diaspora remittances 10%+ GDP/tourism/free zones/gold/nickel/Trujillo (1930-61)/Balaguer/Medina/Abinader/Haiti relations/border/market/culture. Core model: diaspora-driven Confucian merchant development — baseball talent pipeline/diaspora networks/remittances/Confucian merchant families/long-termism/education/philanthropy/transnational ops/Haitian labor/border trade. Exemplifies M210 Diaspora-Driven Confucian Merchant Development — quaternity of 'baseball talent pipeline + diaspora remittance engine + Confucian merchant family networks + Haiti border economy' building diaspora-driven development model amid quadruple challenges of dictatorship legacy/Haiti conflict/middle-income trap/climate vulnerability.
reason_zh: 多米尼加非单纯棒球国家，而是"棒球人才+侨民汇款+儒商家族"三位一体发展引擎。棒球为贫困青年提供阶层跃升通道，侨民汇款支撑家庭消费/投资/教育，儒商家族(阿拉伯/华人/犹太/本地)垂直整合贸易/金融/工业/服务。M210 区隔于 M153 儒商传承(巴拉圭)、M199 马来伊斯兰(文莱)、M201 人民力量(菲律宾)，核心在于"棒球即人才出口+汇款即外部引擎+儒商即内部整合"的加勒比侨民发展范式。
reason_en: Dominican Republic not mere baseball nation but 'baseball talent + diaspora remittances + Confucian merchant families' trinity development engine. Baseball provides mobility ladder for poor youth, diaspora remittances fund household consumption/investment/education, Confucian merchant families (Arab/Chinese/Jewish/local) vertically integrate trade/finance/industry/services. M210 distinct from M153 Confucian Merchant (Paraguay), M199 Malay Islamic (Brunei), M201 People Power (Philippines), core: 'baseball as talent export + remittances as external engine + Confucian merchants as internal integration' Caribbean diaspora development paradigm.
